description: This file defines an enum class 'FileLog' responsible for logging functionality, including starting/stopping logs, writing log lines, and handling log files in a Java project.

classes.name: FileLog
classes.description: An enum class providing logging functionalities such as starting/stopping logs, writing log lines, and managing log files.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Initializes the log file stream if not already opened.

methods.name: openLog
methods.description: Creates and opens a new log file with a timestamped filename.

methods.name: createFolderIfNeeded
methods.description: Creates the output directory if it does not exist.

methods.name: getDate
methods.description: Returns the current date and time formatted as 'yyyy-MM-dd_HH_mm_ss'.

methods.name: logLine
methods.description: Logs a line with a timestamp to the console and file if logging is not suspended.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes the log file stream if it is open.

methods.name: log
methods.description: Logs an exception's stack trace to the log file.

methods.name: logException
methods.description: Logs a message and exception stack trace.
